catalyst_rows.raw_text: In March 2026, the Company announced that Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare approved Effexor SR 37.5 mg / 75 mg capsules (venlafaxine hydrochloride), a serotonin-noradrenaline reuptake inhibitor, for the treatment of adults with generalized anxiety disorder.

In April 2026, the Company announced that four abstracts were presented at the American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgery Annual Meeting in Washington, D.C., April 10-13, 2026. The presentations included data across various areas of ophthalmology, including full results from VEGA-3, a Phase 3 study evaluating MR-141 (phentolamine ophthalmic solution 0.75%) for presbyopia.

catalyst_rows.asset: Low-dose estrogen weekly patch (150 mcg norelgestromin + 17.5 mcg ethinyl estradiol)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: In May 2026, the Company announced that six abstracts on its investigational low dose estrogen weekly patch ... presented at the 2026 ACOG Annual Clinical & Scientific Meeting ... included positive results from the previously announced Phase 3 study evaluating the contraceptive efficacy and safety.
